inspection_method: Sequential MATLAB 5 MAT inspection using SciPy whosmat/loadmat; arrays released between files.

files.biological_independence_status: unknown; filenames and variable labels do not establish an independent plant
known_limitations: No plant, leaf, scan, replicate, or acquisition-date linkage is present in the file header or Zenodo record.
No wavelength vector or per-file wavelength calibration is present in the MAT variables.
Per-file reflectance/calibration procedure and reference arrays are not included or linked.
Class label is derived from the filename; no per-file laboratory ground-truth record is supplied.
Values span 0 to 4095; this is not evidence that the array is reflectance.
